gloss: tenant (of a rented house or room)

definitions.explanation: A person who rents a house or room from a landlord. Old-fashioned, best known from the set pair {大家|おおや}と{店子|たなこ} (landlord and tenant); in modern use {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ} or {借|か}り{手|て} is usual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{店子|たなこ}。
⟦{長屋|ながや}→長屋：25330_nagaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{店子|たなこ}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よかった。
examples.english: The tenants of the row house got along well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人情|にんじょう}→人情：11437_ninjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{貧|まず}しい→貧しい：02349_mazushii⟧{店子|たなこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rakugo stories often feature a kindly landlord and his poor tenants.

notes:
The {店|たな} is an old word for a rented dwelling. The saying ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いえば⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同然|どうぜん}→同然：09487_douzen⟧、{店子|たなこ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いえば⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同然|どうぜん}→同然：09487_douzen⟧ ("a landlord is like a parent, a tenant like a child") reflects the close Edo-period relationship.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧: landlord — the partner word
- ⟦{家主|やぬし}→家主：04079_yanushi⟧: landlord, house owner (more formal)
- ⟦{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}→入居者：20979_nyuukyosha⟧: tenant, resident — the modern term
